Common questions

How many games will the Seattle Seahawks win in 2026?

Across 10,000 simulated seasons the Seattle Seahawks average 12.1 wins, with eight of every ten seasons between 10 and 14. Games already played count at their real result.

What are the Seattle Seahawks' playoff odds?

They make the playoffs in 91% of simulated seasons, win the NFC West in 64% and earn the 1 seed in 35%, with every season seeded by the NFL's tiebreakers.

How is the Seahawks simulation built?

Each remaining game is decided by that game's own win probability from the TrustMyRecord NFL model, the drive level model behind the NFL Simulator, and the season is replayed 10,000 times. The page is rebuilt twice a day from the latest schedule and results.
